parrafo_1.es: Beauty Beyond Beauty Head Spa es un espacio en Pembroke Pines donde el cuidado del cabello se une al sound bath y a la aromaterapia. Cada ritual esta pensado para que salgas con el cuero cabelludo renovado y la mente en calma.
parrafo_1.en: Beauty Beyond Beauty Head Spa is a space in Pembroke Pines where hair care meets sound bath and aromatherapy. Every ritual is built so you leave with a renewed scalp and a quiet mind.

parrafo_2.es: Nuestra especialidad es la Hairapy: tratamientos personalizados segun la densidad y el estado de tu cabello, desde un reset rapido de 30 minutos hasta un viaje de reparacion de 6 meses.
parrafo_2.en: Our specialty is Hairapy: treatments personalized to your hair's density and condition, from a quick 30-minute reset to a 6-month repair journey.

texto.es: Eliges tu hairapy en nuestro sistema de citas y confirmas en minutos.
texto.en: Pick your hairapy in our booking system and confirm in minutes.

texto.es: Analizamos la densidad y el estado de tu cabello para personalizar el tratamiento.
texto.en: We look at your hair's density and condition to personalize the treatment.

texto.es: Masaje de cuero cabelludo, mascarilla y un sound bath relajante durante la pausa.
texto.en: A scalp massage, a mask, and a relaxing sound bath during the pause.

texto.es: Sales con el cabello hidratado, el corte al dia y el cuero cabelludo renovado.
texto.en: You leave with hydrated hair, a fresh cut and a renewed scalp.

nota.es: Precios reales del menu de servicios. Varios tratamientos tienen precio final segun largo y densidad del cabello.
nota.en: Real prices from our service menu. Several treatments have a final price based on hair length and density.

texto.es: Elimina residuos de productos, agua dura y contaminantes con mascarilla y masaje de cuero cabelludo.
texto.en: Removes product residue, hard water and pollutant buildup with a mask and scalp massage.

texto.es: Limpieza suave del cuero cabelludo, masaje y aromaterapia para liberar tension en poco tiempo.
texto.en: A gentle scalp cleanse, massage and aromatherapy to release tension in little time.

texto.es: Masaje de cuero cabelludo en seco con movimientos intencionales para soltar tension profunda.
texto.en: A dry scalp massage with intentional movements to release deep tension.

texto.es: Detox, tratamiento personalizado, styling y terapia de crecimiento con radiofrecuencia.
texto.en: Detox, a customized treatment, styling and hair growth therapy with radiofrequency.

pie.es: Tambien: Renew & Repair Hairapy (programa de 6 meses), Color Reset, detangling y cortes. Escribenos por el menu completo.
pie.en: Also available: Renew & Repair Hairapy (6-month program), Color Reset, detangling and haircuts. Message us for the full menu.

items.quote: Juliana is an amazing hairstylist! Since she started treating my scalp, I've noticed such a positive difference, it is in much better condition and feels so much healthier.
I honestly don't even know where to start because Juliana has changed the way I feel about my hair completely. When I first came to her, my hair was damaged, and the color didn't really suit me.
I really appreciate the unique, holistic approach here, it's something you don't find often, and it's one of the reasons I enjoy coming. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting.
